advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sengejja ennaku za kaadi ng’okozesa @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt oba @listEnteredAt. Ekyokulabirako: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' oba @endAt = none. Teeka erinnya ly’ekifo kye weetegekedde eritandika ne @ wakati w’obubonero obw’okujuliza.
advanced-filter-description: Advanced Sengeka allows eri write string containing following operators: ==!= <= >= && || ( ) space kiri kyakozesebwa nga separator between Operators. Ggwe sobola sengeka ku lwa byonna ennimiro ez'enjawulo nga typing byabwe names ne miwendo. Ku lwa Example: Nnimiro1 == Muwendo1. Note: Singa nnimiro oba miwendo contains spaces, ggwe need eri encapsulate them into single quotes. Ku lwa Example: 'Nnimiro 1' == 'Muwendo 1'. Ku lwa single control characters (' \/) eri ba skipped, ggwe sobola kozesa \. Ku lwa example: Nnimiro1 == I\'m. Also ggwe sobola combine multiple conditions. Ku lwa Example: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Normally byonna operators biri interpreted okuva kkono eri ddyo. Ggwe sobola kyusa order nga placing brackets. Ku lwa Example: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Also ggwe sobola noonya bigambo nnimiro ng'okozesa regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i

blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: salako amabanga ku ludda olwa ddyo olwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Zzaayo kkopi y'ebigambo ng'amabanga gaggyiddwako ku nkomerero emu oba zombi.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Ekikyuka ekiyitibwa '%1' kiriwo dda ku kika ekirala: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Ekikyuka ekiyitibwa '%1' kiriwo dda nga parameter mu fankisoni '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_MANY: Entuumu %1 eza bulooka%2 mu kifo ky'okukoleramu.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Entuumu emu eya bulooka%2 mu kifo ky'okukoleramu.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Noonya mu kifo ky'okukoleramu. Nyiga Enter okufuna ekikwatagana ekiddako, Shift+Enter ekikwatagana ekivuddeko. Nyiga Escape okuggalawo okunoonya n'okussa essira ku kikwatagana ekiriwo.
board-status-remaining-time-total: Ekiseera ekisigadde okutuuka ku lunaku olw'enkomerero
bots-none: Tewannabaawo bboti. Bboti kidduka ku seeva yo - omukozi wa AI, omulimu gwa CI, sikulipiti - olubaawo luno lwe luwa kaadi.
card-archive-pop: Kaadi kijja si ba kirabika ku kino lukalala after archiving kaadi.
card-archive-suggest-cancel: Ggwe sobola later zzaawo kaadi okuva Tterekero.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ya SuperAdmin yekka, ku Domeeni ya Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Ne WeKan mu Weddy, Cloud Panel ekola ku domeeni nnyingi eza WeKan okuva ku seva emu, buli emu n'ebiwandiiko byayo. Ku Domeeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin addukanya domeeni ne CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: N'ekisumuluzo kya CloudFlare API, domeeni ng'ekitundu kyayo kiri mu akawunti yo eya CloudFlare efuna ekiwandiiko kya DNS ekiyita mu proxy ne satifikeeti ya CloudFlare Origin. Domeeni endala zifuna satifikeeti ya Let's Encrypt. Ekisumuluzo kiterekebwa ku seva era tekiddamu kulagibwa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Tewali kisumuluzo kya CloudFlare API kiterekeddwa: buli domeeni efuna satifikeeti ya Let's Encrypt.
confirm-checklist-delete-popup: okakasa ggwe yagala eri sangula lukalala-lw'okukebera?
creator: Omutonzi
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Empagi endala ez'okuyingiza nga ennimiro ez'enjawulo ez'ebigambo:
csv-mapping-description: Londa empagi ya fayiro erimu buli nnimiro ya kaadi. Ebirondeddwa byakolebwa okuva ku mannya g'empagi; kyusa byonna ebikyamu, era londa (tekiri mu fayiro) ku nnimiro fayiro gy'etalina.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Fayiro terina mpagi ya lukalala. Londa emu waggulu, oba wandiika erinnya ly'olukalala olumu buli kaadi mw'egenda.
csv-mapping-list-required: Wandiika erinnya ly'olukalala buli kaadi mw'egenda, oba londa empagi erimu olukalala.
csv-mapping-title-required: Londa empagi erimu amannya ga kaadi.
delete-all-notifications-confirm: okakasa ggwe yagala eri sangula byonna okumanyisa? Kino kikolwa tasobola ba undone.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Okutuusa tekwasobodde kukakasibwa; kyekenneenye nga tonnaddamu kugezaako
email-invite-register-text:
Dear __user__, __inviter__ invites ggwe eri kanban lubaawo ku lwa collaborations. Please follow kakwate below:
__url__ Ne kyo okuyita code kiri: __icode__ Thanks.
email-recovery-busy: Okuweereza oba omulimu omulala ogw'olunyiriri gukolebwa. Zza buggya era gezaako nate oluvannyuma lw'akaseera.
email-recovery-changed: Enkyukakyuka esembayo ey'omukozi akola ku nkola
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Sazaamu obubaka bwonna obuli mu lunyiriri kati obw'omuntu ono? Ebirimu bijja kuggyibwawo era tebisobola kukomezebwawo. Obubaka obupya obukoleddwa oluvannyuma lw'okusaba kuno bujja kusigalawo.
email-recovery-description: Olunyiriri lumu ku buli afuna obubaka. Noonya ng'okozesa ID y'omukozesa. Ebirimu mu bubaka n'ebifo by'imeyilo y'afuna obubaka tebiragibwa. Okuyimiriza okumala akaseera kukwata obubaka obuliwo n'obujja; Okugenda mu maaso kuddamu okugezaako okuweereza obubaka obuli mu lunyiriri kati. Okusazaamu kuggyawo obubaka obwateekebwa mu lunyiriri okutuuka ku ssaawa y'okusaba. Bwe kiba nti okuweereza kukyagenda mu maaso, gezaako nate oluvannyuma lw'akaseera. Obubaka obwatandise okuweerezebwa tebusobola kukomezebwawo, era okuweereza okutakakasiddwa kusobola okuddamu. Okulemererwa okw'olubeerera n'obubaka obutuuse ku kkomo ly'okugezaako bisigalawo okwekebejjebwa. Okuddamu okugezaako obubaka obwalemererwa kutandika oluzingulula olupya olw'okugezaako era kukuuma okuyimiriza okw'akaseera okuliwo.
email-recovery-empty: Tewali bubaka mu lunyiriri era tewali bafuna obubaka abayimiriziddwa okuweerezebwa okumala akaseera.
email-recovery-failed: Omulimu tegusobose kukakasibwa. Zza olunyiriri buggya era gezaako nate ekikolwa kye kimu bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
email-recovery-superseded: Ekikolwa ekipya eky'omukozi akola ku nkola kizzewo okusaba kuno. Embeera y'olunyiriri eya kati eragibwa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Tekisobose okusoma olunyiriri lw'imeyilo. Kebera olukusa lw'omuddukanya n'okuba nti seva esobola okutuukibwako.
email-resetPassword-text: Hello __user__, Eri reset kyo kigambo-kyama, simply click kakwate below. __url__ Thanks.
email-verifyEmail-text: Hello __user__, Eri verify kyo akaawunti imeyilo, simply click kakwate below. __url__ Thanks.
error-json-malformed: Kyo bigambo kiri si kikkirizibwa JSON
error-json-schema: Kyo JSON mawulire does si include proper information mu correct format
error-ldap-login: nsobi occurred while trying eri okuyingira
error-notAuthorized: Ggwe biri si authorized eri laba kino muko.
export-card-details: Kaadi ebisingawo (each kaadi nga mu kaadi fulumya)
filter-on-desc: Ggwe biri filtering kaadi ku kino lubaawo. Click here eri kyusa sengeka.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Ekyafulumizibwa kyogera amannya g'ebiyungiddwako naye tekitwala fayiro zennyini. Okuzireeta, wandiika endagiriro y'empeereza n'eby'okuyingira: bikozesebwa ku kuyingiza kuno kwokka, bisindikibwa ku ndagiriro eyo yokka, era tebiterekebwa. Leka kikalu okuyingiza nga tewali fayiro.
import-attachment-auth-token: Akabonero ka API, ekisumuluzo kya API oba ekigambo ekyekusifu eky'app
import-board-instruction-asana: Teekamu Asana mirimu fulumya JSON ({ "data": [...] } okuva Asana fulumya oba GET /tasks). Mirimu biri grouped into sections (memberships); kiwedde mirimu go eri Done.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Mu Businessmap (edda Kanbanize), ggulawo Advanced Search, londa Configure results okulonda empagi, wanula fayiro ya Excel, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo .xlsx. Empagi zisomebwa n'amannya gaazo ag'Olungereza (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): akawunti yo bw'ekozesa olulimi olulala, sooka okyuse olunyiriri lw'emitwe lubeere mu Lungereza. Column efuuka enkalala ne Lane obukubo; bannannyini, obubonero, langi, ennaku, endowooza ne link z'abazadde bikuuma ebifo byabyo, ne Priority, Size, Type n'empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Mu ClickUp, fulumya emirimu nga CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, oba okufulumya kw'endabika ya List oba Table n'empagi zonna), oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala, enkalala za ClickUp zifuuka obukubo, n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi n'emirimu emitono, abaweereddwa omulimu, obubonero, ennaku, obukulu n'obudde.
import-board-instruction-csv: Teekamu mu kyo Comma Separated Miwendo(CSV)/ Tab Separated Miwendo (TSV).
import-board-instruction-deck: Teekamu NextCloud Deck lubaawo JSON ( lubaawo na "stacks", each stack carrying kyakyo "cards"). Stacks become nkalala ne kaadi become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-excel: Londa WeKan-style.xlsx spreadsheet ( kimu columns nga Excel fulumya: Mutwe, Kunnyonnyola, Mbeera/Lukalala, Bamemba, Obubonero, dates, ennimiro ez'enjawulo). kisooka row kiri header.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Ggya fayiro ya .boardarchive mu zip era osseewo ebiri mu board.jsonl y’olubaawo, n’olunyiriri lw’ekika oba nga teruliiko. Ekintu ekigabanya mu bibinja mu ndabika y’olubaawo kifuuka enkalala, ebintu ebirala eby’okulonda bifuuka obubonero, ebitundu by’ebiwandiiko n’obubokisi obw’okuteekamu akabonero bifuuka ennyonyola n’olukalala lw’okukebera, era endowooza zikuumibwa. Ebifaananyi ne fayiro ezigattiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-issues: Teekamu __sourceName__ issues JSON array (__endpoint__). Issues become kaadi grouped into Ggulawo / Closed nkalala.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Teekamu Kanboard fulumya JSON: object na "columns" (oba mirimu carrying column_name) ne "tasks" array (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns become nkalala ne mirimu become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Mu Kanri, ggulawo Import & Export olonde Export individual board (oba Export all data), oluvannyuma oteekemu fayiro .json. Empagi zifuuka enkalala ne kaadi zifuuka kaadi, n'ennyonyola yaazo, olunaku olusembayo, obubonero ne langi; emirimu gya kaadi gifuuka olukalala lw'okukebera. Okuva mu kufulumya kwa data yonna, olubaawo olusooka lwe luyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-leo: Siiga ensengeka ya Leo (fayiro ya .leo). Ebitundu eby'oku mutendera ogw'oku ntikko bifuuka enkalala, ebitundu ebiri wansi waabyo butereevu bifuuka kaadi, era ebiwandiiko by'ekitundu bifuuka ennyonyola ya kaadi. Ebitundu eby'oku mitendera egy'omu munda ennyo bifuuka enkalala z'okukebera. Ebitundu ebiteereddwako akabonero biyingizibwa nga ebiwedde.
import-board-instruction-linear: Mu Linear, fulumya ensonga nga CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, oba okufulumya kw'endabika), oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala, ttiimu zifuuka obukubo, n'ensonga zifuuka kaadi n'aweereddwa omulimu, obubonero, ennaku, ensonga enkulu, obukulu, okubalirira, pulojekiti ne cycle.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Kwatako olukalala lw'emirimu olwa markdown (empisa emikozesebwa ebikozesebwa markdown-kanban nga Obsidian Kanban): emitwe "## Erinnya ly'olukalala", n'ebintu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" wansi. Emitwe gifuuka olukalala n'ebintu bifuuka kaadi.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Mu MeisterTask, nyiga ku linnya lya pulojekiti, londa Export project ofulumye CSV, oluvannyuma ogiteekemu. Ebitundu bifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'ebbaluwa zaagyo, olunaku olusembayo, aweereddwa omulimu n'obubonero; emirimu egyaggwa gikuuma olunaku lwe gyaggwerako. CSV ewandiikiddwa olw'okuyingiza kwa MeisterTask yennyini nayo ekola.
import-board-instruction-monday: Mu monday.com, ggulawo menu y'olubaawo, londa More actions ne Export board to Excel (n'ebipya n'ebintu ebitono bw'oba oyagala), oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo .xlsx. Empagi ya Status efuuka enkalala n'ebibinja bifuuka obukubo; abantu, ennaku, timeline n'obubonero bikuuma ebifo byabyo, empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo n'ebipya bifuuka endowooza.
import-board-instruction-notion: Mu Notion, ggulawo database nga olupapula olujjuvu, londa ••• ne Export, londa Markdown & CSV, olonde fayiro .zip gy'ewanula, oba CSV emu eya database okuva mu yo, oba oteekemu CSV eyo. Empagi erinnya Status efuuka enkalala (bw'etabaawo, empagi esooka efaanana nga select y'ekola, era alipoota y'okuyingiza egamba eriwa); ennyiriri zifuuka kaadi n'erinnya lyazo, obubonero nga obubonero, abantu nga bamemba, ennaku, n'ebigambo by'olupapula nga ennyonyola; empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo. Enkolagana, ebifaananyi n'ebiyungiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Mu Nullboard, ggulawo olubaawo, londa Export this board... okuva ku menu, ggulawo fayiro .nbx mu kawandiisi k'ebigambo oteekemu by'erimu. Enkalala zifuuka enkalala n'ebbaluwa zifuuka kaadi: olunyiriri olusooka olw'ebbaluwa lwe linnya lya kaadi n'ebisigadde ennyonyola yaayo. Ebbaluwa embisi efuna akabonero raw. Fayiro erimu embaawo eziwerako eyingiza olubaawo lwayo olusooka.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Mu Obsidian, ggulawo fayiro y'olubaawo lwa Kanban nga Markdown (oba ggulawo fayiro .md mu kawandiisi k'ebigambo), oluvannyuma oteekemu yonna. Emikutu gifuuka enkalala n'ekkomo lyazo erya kaadi, kaadi zikuuma obubonero bwazo, ennaku, obukulu, ennimiro n'olukalala lw'okukebera, ne Archive efuuka kaadi eziri mu Tterekero.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Teekamu OpenProject work-packages collection JSON (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses become nkalala ne work packages become kaadi.
import-board-instruction-opml: Teekamu OPML outline, nga Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq n'ebirala bwe bigifulumya. Ebintu eby'oku ntikko bifuuka enkalala, abaana baabyo bifuuka kaadi nga ebbaluwa efuuka ennyonyola, n'ebintu ebiri wansi ennyo bifuuka enkalala z'okukebera. Ebintu ebyaggwa biyingizibwa nga biwedde.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Teekamu fayiro ya Org mode, nga Emacs, Orgzly oba Beorg bwe bigiwandiika. Emitwe egy'oku ntikko gifuuka enkalala n'emitwe egy'omutendera ogwokubiri gifuuka kaadi. TODO ne DONE, obukulu, obubonero, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE ne CLOSED bikuumibwa, n'obusanduuko bw'okukebera n'emitwe egiri wansi ennyo bifuuka enkalala z'okukebera.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Mu Pivotal Tracker, ggulawo ttabu MORE eya pulojekiti olonde Export CSV (oba londa emboozi olonde Bulk Actions, CSV), oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Buli mbeera y'emboozi efuuka olukalala n'emboozi zifuuka kaadi, n'ekika kyazo n'obubonero, bannannyini, eyasaba, ennaku, endowooza, emirimu n'ebiziyiza; Estimate efuuka Story points n'enkulungo zifuuka sprints.
import-board-instruction-plane: Mu Plane, ggulawo Workspace Settings, londa Exports, fulumya pulojekiti nga JSON, CSV oba Excel owanule fayiro .zip, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo, oba fayiro emu okuva munda mu yo, oba oteekemu JSON oba CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala, pulojekiti zifuuka obukubo, n'ensonga zifuuka kaadi n'akabonero kaazo, omuzadde, abaweereddwa omulimu, obubonero, ennaku, link n'endowooza; obukulu, okubalirira, cycle ne module bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo. Okufulumya kwa Plane tekulina nnyonyola wadde ebiyungiddwako, kale tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-quire: Mu Quire, ggulawo menu ya pulojekiti olonde Export CSV, oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Embeera zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'emirimu emitono nga kaadi z'abaana, abaweereddwa omulimu, obubonero nga obubonero, ennaku ez'okutandika, ez'okusembayo n'ez'okuggwa, ennyonyola n'obukulu nga ennimiro ey'enjawulo. Endowooza n'ebiyungiddwako tebiri mu CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Mu Redmine, ggulawo Issues za pulojekiti, londa Also available in: CSV wansi w'olukalala, londa empagi (All columns, ne Description) ofulumye, oluvannyuma oteekemu CSV. Redmine etuuma empagi mu lulimi lwo, kale teeka olulimi lwo ku Lungereza mu My account nga tonnafulumya. Buli mbeera efuuka olukalala n'ensonga zifuuka kaadi, ne tracker nga akabonero, aweereddwa omulimu, omuwandiisi, ennaku, omulimu omukulu n'ensonga ezikwatagana; obukulu, ekika, version egendererwa, obudde obubaliriddwa, % Done n'ennimiro ez'enjawulo bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Mu Super Productivity, ggulawo Settings, oluvannyuma Sync & Backup, londa Export Data oteekemu by'erimu mu fayiro sp-backup .json. Buli pulojekiti efuuka akakubo n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi mu To Do, In Progress, Backlog oba Done, n'ebbaluwa zaagyo, obubonero, olunaku olusembayo, obudde obwakozesebwa n'emirimu emitono; emirimu egiri mu Tterekero gifuuka kaadi eziri mu Tterekero.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Mu Taiga, ggulawo Admin > Project > Export owanule dump ya pulojekiti (sooka osumulule fayiro .json.gz), oluvannyuma oteekemu JSON yaayo. Embeera za user story zifuuka enkalala, user stories zifuuka kaadi n'emirimu gyazo nga emirimu emitono, epics n'ensonga bifuna obukubo bwabyo, era sprints, obubonero, endowooza n'ebifaananyi eby'enjawulo bijja wamu. Ebiyungiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Mu Tasks.org, ggulawo Settings, Backups olonde Export tasks, oluvannyuma oteekemu by'erimu mu fayiro eyo .json. Enkalala zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'ebbaluwa zaagyo, obubonero, ennaku, endowooza n'emirimu emitono; emirimu egyaggwa gikuuma olunaku lwe gyaggwerako, n'obukulu bufuuka ennimiro ey'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ssaawo ebivudde mu task export: olukalala lwa JSON oba omulimu gumu ku buli lunyiriri. Emirimu egyaggwa gigenda mu Done, project ne priority bifuuka obubonero, annotations efuuka endowooza, ate depends efuuka okwesigama ku mirimu egiziyiza.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Mu Teamwork.com, jjuza template y'okuyingiza emirimu mu Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) ogitereke nga .xlsx, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo. Enkalala z'emirimu zifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi; omulimu ogutandika ne -, # oba > gufuuka omulimu omutono ogw'omulimu oguli waggulu waagwo (--, ## oba >> omutendera gumu wansi). Abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku n'obubonero bikuuma ebifo byabyo; Priority, Estimated time ne Complete bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Mu TickTick, ggulawo Settings, Account, Backup & Import okole backup, oluvannyuma oteekemu fayiro ya CSV. Buli lukalala lwa TickTick lufuuka akakubo n'empagi zaalwo zifuuka enkalala; emirimu gikuuma obubonero bwagyo, ennaku, olukalala lw'okukebera, obukulu n'emirimu emitono.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Teeka fayiro ya todo.txt: omulimu gumu ku buli lunyiriri, nga pulogulaamu ya todo.txt ne pulogulaamu ezikwatagana bwe zigiwandiika. Emirimu egyaggwa ("x") gigenda mu Giwedde, +project ne @context bifuuka obubonero, (A) efuuka akabonero k'obukulu, era due: ne t: bifuuka ennaku ez'okusibako n'ez'okutandika.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Mu Vikunja, ggulawo Settings, londa Data Export owanule fayiro .zip gy'ekuweereza, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo, oba oteekemu data.json erimu. Ebibbo bya Kanban bifuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, n'obubonero bwagyo, abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku, ennyonyola, enkalala z'emirimu nga enkalala z'okukebera n'endowooza; obukulu, ebitundu ku kikumi ebyaggwa ne done bifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo. Ebiyungiddwako tebiyingizibwa.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Mu Wrike, fulumya pulojekiti oba folda okugiteeka mu Excel, oba jjuza template y'okuyingiza Excel eya Wrike, oluvannyuma olonde fayiro eyo .xlsx. Ennyiriri za folda ne pulojekiti zifuuka obukubo, Status efuuka enkalala n'emirimu gifuuka kaadi, ne Key yaagyo, omulimu omukulu, abaweereddwa omulimu, ennaku ez'okutandika n'ez'okuggwa, ebyesigamiziddwako n'ennyonyola; Priority, Duration n'empagi endala zifuuka ennimiro ez'enjawulo.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Teekamu ZenKit lukalala fulumya JSON ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages become nkalala ne items become kaadi.
import-file-label: Londa fayiro y'okufulumya, oba teekamu ebigambo byayo wansi:
import-members-map: Kyo yaleeta lubaawo has some bamemba. Please map bamemba ggwe yagala eri leeta eri kyo bakozesa
import-members-map-note: Note: Unmapped bamemba kijja ba assigned eri ekiriwo mukozesa.
import-members-mode-map: Londa omukozesa aliwo eri buli omu ku bo
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bakuume nga abakozesa ab'ekifo n'amannya gaabwe, okubagatta ku bakozesa ab'amazima oluvannyuma
import-not-wekan-export: Ekyo fayiro kiri si WeKan fulumya
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Buli kakubo okuyingiza kwe kwandikoze (pulojekiti, folda oba olukalala lw'ekikozesebwa) kufuuka olubaawo lwako. Kaadi enkulu n'ebyesigamiziddwako wakati w'embaawo ezo biwandiikibwa mu alipoota y'okuyingiza.
import-report-description: Olubaawo lukoleddwa, naye ebitundu ebimu ebya fayiro tebyasobodde kuleetebwa. Lipoota y'emu eterekeddwa mu Ekifo ky'abaddukanya → Bizibu → Okuzzaawo.
import-too-large: Fayiro nnene nnyo okugireeta omulundi gumu. Gigabanyemu fayiro entono, okugeza okusinziira ku pulojekiti oba ku nnaku z'omwezi, oleete buli emu.
instance-desc: Buli mukozesa ayingidde mu WeKan eno asobola okulaba olubaawo luno. Terulaga bantu batayingidde n’akatono. Abantu abongereddwa ku lubaawo bokka be basobola okulukyusa.

r-insert-variable: Teeka akabonero akakiikirira omuwendo ogukyuka mu kifo ky'ebiwandiiko kye wasembyeyo okulonda:

r-trigger-vars-hint: Ebifo by’olukalala, akakubo, omutwe, olukalala lw’okukebera n’omukozesa bikkiriza ne {creator}, {assignees}, {members} ne {customField:Name}. Emiwendo gyabyo gisomebwa okuva ku kaadi nga etteeka likeberwa.
r-vars-people-hint: Nabyo: {creator}, {assignees}, {members} (amannya g’abakozesa mu biwandiiko, endagiriro za imeyiri mu kifo ky’oyo afuna) ne {customField:Field name}. Bino bikola ne mu mannya g’abammemba, enkalala n’obukubo eby’ebikolwa ebirala.

r-when-a-end-date-changed: Olunaku olw'okumaliriza bwe luteekebwawo oba bwe lukyusibwa

r-workflow-help: Drag trigger ne kikolwa into builder, olwo yongerako tteeka. Drag kikolwa onto existing tteeka eri kyusa ki kyo does.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Workflow ya Wrike lukalala lw'embeera, buli emu mu kibinja Active, Completed, Deferred oba Cancelled. Okufulumya kuwandiika enkalala z'olubaawo luno nga workflow emu, etuumiddwa erinnya ly'olubaawo, mu JSON API ya Wrike gy'ezzaayo ku workflows: kola workflow eyo mu Wrike nga tonnayingiza kufulumya kwa Excel okwa Wrike okw'olubaawo, embeera zaayo zisobole okukozesebwa. Okuyingiza kusoma JSON eyo eteekeddwamu waggulu, okuva mu WeKan oba mu GET /workflows eya Wrike, mu lubaawo olulondeddwa: embeera etalina lukalala efuuka olukalala, era etteeka liteeka akabonero nti kaadi ewedde bw'etambuzibwa mu mbeera ya Completed oba Cancelled, era nti tewedde mu mbeera ya Active oba Deferred. Amateeka ga Wrike ag'okwekolera tegasobola kufulumizibwa okuva mu Wrike.
recovery-no-events: Nedda okuzzaawo events recorded. etterekero-ly'amawulire kiri healthy.
recovery-report-desc: Automatic data-safety ne remediation ebikolwa: corruption detection, text-data backups, restores, re-migration okuva MongoDB, ne automatic repair lya bloated etterekero-ly'amawulire.

text-contains-trigger-description: Kikwatagana ekaadi bweteekebwawo, oba omutwe oba ennyinyonyola yaayo bwe kikyusibwa, era ebigambo ebipya bwe biba nga birimu kino (enkuyunjula z'ennukuta ennene n'entono tezisosola).
